smote.interpretation: Algorithmic SMOTE control on standardized tabular features; synthetic-record physical validity is not asserted.

route_semantics.C_CL_MLP_loss_fair: Legacy route identifier. The schedule matches 30 nominal epochs but processes fewer rows than 30 full-data epochs; it is not compute matched.
route_semantics.F_KD_from_CL_MLP_fair: Student distilled from C_CL_MLP_loss_fair. The inherited 'fair' token is a legacy identifier, not an equal-compute claim.
route_semantics.C_CL_MLP_loss_ext: Extended curriculum schedule with 40 nominal epochs and nonuniform row exposure.
route_semantics.I_SMOTE_MLP_teacher: Algorithmic SMOTE control on standardized tabular features; synthetic-record physical validity is not asserted.

A_calibrated_RF_KD_teacher.resource_scope: The calibrated RF was not serialized in the base run. Tree-node memory and artifact bytes are therefore unavailable and are not inferred.
